Id: # Map interactables (ASQShrine / ASQPot). Scattered fresh every night by ASQArena with a deterministic seed (biome + night).

# Type: Charge (stand in Radius for ChargeSeconds; each extra reaper in the ring adds CoopBonus to the charge speed; then everyone who was in range picks 1 of Choices stat boosts by standing on a pedestal)

#       Relic (walk in: Choices item pedestals; the first reaper to stand on one takes it) | Challenge (Count x Enemy now + again at half time; survive Duration s within Value2 cm: free chest + Value gold each)
#       Greed (Value gold each x (1 + 0.5 x night) now; Value2 permanent difficulty) | Magnet (activator's pickup range +Value for Duration s: every soul and XP spark flies to them)
#       Cursed (Count temp copies of tonight's legend at Value x boss HP
Name: one at a time; each kill = free chest + Value2 gold each; copies vanish at midnight)

Id: #       Key (pick up: unlocks the Sealed Crypt for the team) | Crypt (needs the key: free chest + Value gold each) | Pot (smashed by walking into it or by auto-attacks in range)

Name: empty = all. PerBiome: copies per night. Chance: per-copy spawn chance. HighGround: share placed on plateau tops.

Id: # Secret=1: only placed in biomes whose Biomes.csv Secrets column lists the Id. Hidden=1: buried
Name: stand on it for Value seconds to dig it up.

Id: # Rarity: minimum rarity of the offers (0 Common .. 3 Legendary). Charge Boosts: Stat:Amount at Common (x1.4 / 1.9 / 2.6 at Rare / Epic / Legendary).
# Pot Boosts = loot table Kind:Weight:Amount (Gold and XP x (1 + 0.5 x night); Heal = fraction of max HP; Coins = banked gold to the smasher's profile).
# Model = Art/Props/SM_<Model> (primitive stand-in when missing). Height in cm. Color + Glow = accent glow.

Name: Performance Review Shrine
Prompt: STAND IN THE RING FOR YOUR PERFORMANCE REVIEW
Description: Death reviews your work. More reapers in the ring = a faster review. Everyone in range picks a raise.

Name: Employee of the Month Shrine
Prompt: EMPLOYEE OF THE MONTH: STAND IN THE RING
Description: Rare golden shrine, usually up on the high ground. Legendary raises only.

Name: Buried Bonus
Prompt: SOMETHING GOLDEN IS BURIED HERE: STAND ON IT TO DIG
Description: Secret: a golden shrine someone buried to avoid sharing the bonus. Dig it up (stand on the glint), then charge it.

Name: Lost Property Desk
Prompt: LOST PROPERTY: WALK ONTO ONE ITEM TO KEEP IT
Description: Unclaimed belongings of the recently departed. The first reaper to claim one closes the desk.

Name: Complaints Bell
Description: Grave Brutes arrive to complain. Survive 30 s near the bell: a free chest and gold for everyone.

Name: Petty Cash Coffin
Prompt: PETTY CASH: TAKE THE GOLD (THE HORDE GETS MEANER)
Description: Gold for everyone now. The horde remembers: +8% difficulty for the rest of the run.

Name: Collections Altar
Prompt: COLLECTIONS: EVERY SOUL AND SPARK COMES TO YOU
Description: Every soul and XP spark on the map flies to the reaper who touches it (10 s of map-wide pickup range).

Name: Contract Extension Lectern
Prompt: EXTEND A LEGEND'S CONTRACT (BOSS COPY FOR A CHEST)
Description: A temp copy of tonight's legend rises (30% HP). Beat it before midnight: a free chest and gold. It vanishes at midnight.

Name: Groundskeeper's Key
Description: Secret: a golden bone that opens the Sealed Crypt. Always somewhere up high.

Name: Sealed Crypt
Prompt: SEALED CRYPT: FIND THE GROUNDSKEEPER'S KEY
Description: Secret: locked until the team finds the Groundskeeper's Key. Holds a free chest and gold.

Name: Spare Ash Urn
Description: Smash it (walk into it or let your weapons hit it). Gold, XP or a little health.

Name: Pumpkin Pot
Description: The carnival's urns are pumpkins. Same loot.

Name: Silver Urn
Description: Rare. Smash it for 12 banked gold (saved to your profile at once).
